authorization: User asked on 2026-11-10 to run experiment B.
question: In unseen stroke survivors, does the model score the paretic leg lower than the other leg, in agreement with the left-right difference of GDI recomputed from 3D joint angles?
data: Stroke survivors of Van Criekinge et al. 2023 with model scores (studies/20261106-older-normal100, primary records, virtual side-view input) and recomputed limb GDI (studies/20261110-recomputed-gdi, healthy adults as reference). Paretic side from LesionLeft (left lesion means right paretic).
model_legs: Per person, the mean over primary-record windows of each leg, for the baseline and the normal-added ensemble (measured-value calibration). Leg order of the model output is left, right.

metrics.primary: Share of stroke survivors whose paretic leg scores lower than the other leg, per model, with a 95 percent person bootstrap interval; the same share for recomputed GDI as reference.
secondary: Mean paretic minus other-leg difference per model and for recomputed GDI
Pearson correlation between model and recomputed paretic minus other-leg differences
Healthy adults: absolute left-right difference, as a noise reference
